episodes.title: Keep It, Change It or Tear It Down: Fixing Disneyland
episodes.description: after last weeks overrated vs underrated episode apparently put tims disney fan credentials in question audreyann is giving him a chance to redeem himself then were taking over disneyland land by land attraction by attraction were deciding what we would keep change or tear down if we were suddenly in charge of the park should the peoplemover finally come back does autopia need to go what should replace finding nemo could matterhorn become a frozen attraction and somehow we end up designing an aladdin ride through the cave of wonders some ideas are probably pretty good others might get us banned from disneyland tell us what you would keep change or tear down listen to the podcast shop main st dreamers merch follow us on social and learn more about park scout at mainstdreamers com

episodes.title: Inside Pixar Studios! Secret Rooms, Movie Magic & Disney Hot Takes
episodes.description: tim got the chance to step inside pixar animation studios and this week were taking you along were talking about what its actually like inside pixars emeryville campus from the iconic luxo lamp and pixar ball to original concept art cars models secret rooms recording studios movie memorabilia and some pretty incredible pieces of disney history tim shares some of the coolest details from his pixar tour including how artists turn real world research into animated worlds whats hiding around the pixar campus and what it was like seeing the creative process behind movies like cars toy story hoppers and more plus we talk about tims first ride in a driverless waymo through san francisco before putting some disney favorites to the ultimate test overrated underrated or appropriately rated dole whip figment fantasmic disney churros character dining its a small world popcorn buckets and yes the main street electrical parade we have opinions welcome to episode 142 of the dreaming of disney podcast join the main street dreamers community and check out our latest merch mainstdreamers com

episodes.title: We’re Building a Disneyland App to Help You Use Your Phone Less

episodes.title: Disney California Adventure at 25: The Wild Story Behind the Reimagining
episodes.description: on episode 131 of the dreaming of disney were taking you inside the d23 25th anniversary panel for disney california adventure and breaking down everything we learned from the 1995 aspen retreat where michael eisner and imagineers dreamed up a second gate to the budget constraints that shaped the original park to the mind blowing logistics of filming soarin over california were diving deep into how dca was born then we shift into the reimagining era how buena vista street transformed the entrance how pixar pier found its identity the emotional controversial switch from tower of terror to guardians of the galaxy the genius behind cars land and how world of color almost didnt happen until bob iger asked one simple question when can we do this plus audreyann shares why guardians might just be better than tower yes we said it and we reflect on how imagineers honored the past while building the dca we love today if you love park history imagineering stories and behind the scenes disney magic this ones for you
